# Compliance Monitoring and Review Plan

This plan details the essential tasks for maintaining robust compliance and risk management within the organization.

## Key Activities:

*   Monitor AML (Anti-Money Laundering) detection systems on a quarterly basis.
*   Review the internal control framework specifically for Strategy 2026.
*   Update the internal control framework quarterly to ensure ongoing effectiveness.
*   Monitor updates to AML detection standards to ensure compliance with the latest regulations.
*   Review legal risks associated with Strategy 2026.
